table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	Patient=P.Name,
	AdmissionCode=S.AdmissionCode,
	AdmittedOn=PA.Date,
	AdmittedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.UserCode),
	DischargedOn=PA.DischargedOn,
	DischargedBy=(SELECT USERS.UserName FROM USERS WHERE USERCODE = PA.DischargedBy),
	PA.Discharged,
	PatientLocation=(SELECT PL.Name FROM PatientLocation PL WHERE PL.LocationCODE = PA.LocationCode),
	Doctor=(SELECT D.Name FROM Doctors D WHERE D.DoctCode = PA.DoctorCode),
	Details = I.Name,
	Qty=SUM(S.Qty), 
	Qty1=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 1 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty2=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 2 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty3=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 3 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty4=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 4 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty5=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 5 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty6=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 6 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty7=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty8=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 8 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty9=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 9 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty10=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 10 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty11=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 11 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty12=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 12 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty13=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 13 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty14=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 14 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty15=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 15 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty16=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 16 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty17=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 17 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty18=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 18 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty19=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 19 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty20=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 20 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty21=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 21 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty22=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 22 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty23=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 23 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty24=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 24 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty25=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 25 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty26=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 26 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty27=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 27 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty28=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 28 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty29=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 29 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty30=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 30 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	Qty31=SUM(CASE DATEPART(day, S.DATE) WHEN 31 THEN S.Qty ELSE 0 END),
	ItemValue=SUM(S.ItemValue)
FROM
	Patient P,
	PatientAdmission PA,
	Item I,
	(SELECT 
		S.AdmissionCode,
		InvCode=S.SaleInvCode,
		Date=S.Date,
		D.ICode,
		Qty=SUM(D.LooseQty),
		ItemValue=SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice) - 
			SUM((D.looseqty*D.itemflatdisc) +
					(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (.01 * D.discperc)) +
					(D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc) * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * 
					(.01 * S.discperc))) + 
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((D.looseqty * (D.saleprice - D.itemflatdisc)) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01)
	FROM 
		SaleLedger S,	 
		SaleDetail D
	WHERE
		( S.AdmissionCode = :ai_admissioncode)and  
		( S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode )
	GROUP  BY
		S.AdmissionCode,
		S.SaleInvCode,
		D.ICode,	
		S.Date
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		S.AdmissionCode,
		InvCode=S.SRInvCode,
		Date=S.Date,
		D.ICode,
		Qty=-SUM(D.LooseQty),
		ItemValue=-SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SRPrice) - 
			SUM((D.looseqty * D.srprice * (.01 * D.discperc)) +
					(D.looseqty * D.srprice * (1-(.01 * D.discperc)) * 
					(.01 * S.discperc))) + 
			SUM( (D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) + 
			SUM((D.looseqty * D.saleprice) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01)
	FROM 
		SRLedger S,	 
		SRDetail D
	WHERE
		( S.AdmissionCode = :ai_admissioncode)and  
		( S.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode )
	GROUP  BY
		S.AdmissionCode,
		S.SRInvCode,
		D.ICode,	
		S.Date) S
WHERE   
	( PA.AdmissionCode = :ai_admissioncode ) AND
	( PA.PatientCode = P.PatientCode ) AND
	( S.AdmissionCode = PA.AdmissionCode ) AND
	( S.ICode = I.Icode )
GROUP BY 
	P.RegNo,
	P.Name,
	S.AdmissionCode,
	PA.Date,
	PA.UserCode,
	PA.DischargedOn,
	PA.DischargedBy,
	PA.Discharged,
	PA.LocationCode,
	PA.DoctorCode,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name
ORDER BY
	I.Name
table.sort: patient A, regno A, admissioncode A, details A
